API-waarden zijn stabiele snake_case codes; labels zijn vertaalbaar en legacy/app-varianten zijn alleen aliassen.
Deze regels voorkomen dat app, backend en unit ieder een andere waarheid kunnen bewaren.
Every Customer, Location, Project, Unit, WaterProject and UnitComponent has an immutable unique ID.
Project.locationId, Unit.projectId and WaterProject.unitId must exist; no relationship is stored by display name.
Every physical component and port belongs to exactly one Unit.
Allocated component and WaterProject must belong to the same Unit.
An exclusive input/output has at most one active assignment; code unique within Unit + direction.
WaterProject.type must be allowed for its structure according to Enumeraties.
alarmLow < correctLow <= setpoint <= correctHigh < alarmHigh unless the analyte explicitly defines inverse logic.
measuredAt is mandatory; lastTelemetryAt equals the newest accepted snapshot timestamp.
FC and ORP are independently nullable and may both be present.
A protocol is active only when a compatible component is allocated to the WaterProject.
Maximum four cycles per filtration protocol; sequence unique; overlapping intervals require explicit approval.
Store timestamps as UTC; local schedule times are interpreted using Unit.timezone (IANA).
Persist numeric value and canonical unit separately; never persist '20 sec', '5 days' or '30 %' as strings.
Unit.status is computed from lastSeenAt, connectivity and open critical notifications.
Acknowledgement creates an immutable record with user and timestamp; it does not only toggle a boolean.
Wi-Fi password and screen lock code are stored in a secret store/hash and never returned in normal app DTOs.
Dim and all level/progress percentages are integers 0..100.
countryCode is ISO alpha-2; countryName is derived; postal-code validation is country-specific.
Deleting Project/Unit/WaterProject is blocked while active children, components, protocols or unarchived events exist.
Mutable configuration uses optimistic locking through Audit.revision.
available -> scheduled -> downloading -> installing -> succeeded/failed; current and target versions are retained.
Unit payload, backend schema and web DTO include a compatible schemaVersion.

Geprioriteerd op de kans dat het huidige model of de huidige mock tot verkeerde configuratie, dataverlies of onveilige bediening leidt.
Physical pumps, sensors and ports are nested under each WaterProject although they live on the Unit motherboard.
Duplicate port use, impossible reassignment and inconsistent unit inventory.
UnitComponent + PhysicalPort owned by Unit; ComponentAllocation links to WaterProject.
DCM rows 13-22; app uses loc-/PJ-/U-/WP- IDs
Location, Project and several child records lack stable canonical IDs/FKs in the legacy model.
Name-based joins break on rename and duplicate names.
Stable immutable IDs and explicit foreign keys for every entity.
Current pH/ALKA/disinfection values exist in measurements and again inside protocols.
Dashboard and protocol cards can show different current values.
TelemetrySnapshot is source of truth; protocol currentValue is deprecated/derived.
ALKA measurement/dosage connections are optional, while ALKA protocols always exist.
Protocols can be configured without hardware.
Mock generation makes FC and ORP mutually exclusive; the unit UI supports FC + ORP.
Independent nullable channels plus free_chlorine_orp sensor mode.
Dashboard badges use hardcoded thresholds instead of configured MeasurementControl thresholds.
Displayed risk may contradict the actual installation settings.
Join latest telemetry with the active threshold configuration.
Relationships are stored by display name or 'name (id)' text.
Renames and duplicate component names corrupt references.
All relationships use IDs; names are presentation only.
The mock has three filtration cycles; the unit supports four.
Fourth device cycle disappears from the web app.
lastView has no clear meaning and individual measurements have no measuredAt timestamp.
Stale telemetry can look current; user viewing time is confused with device data time.
Rename to lastTelemetryAt and require TelemetrySnapshot.measuredAt.
Acknowledgement is a mutable boolean without actor or timestamp.
No audit trail or reliable multi-user conflict handling.
Status and inactivity are stored independently from lastSeen.
Derive status/inactivity from lastSeen, connectivity and open notifications.
app.js fields such as '20 sec', '5 days', '30 %'
Numbers and units are persisted as display strings.
Sorting, validation, localisation and unit conversion become fragile.
Persist numeric value plus canonical unit; format only in UI.
Three legacy labels identify two different properties each.
Writes/readbacks can address the wrong value.
Canonical IDs are unique; keep the legacy label only as compatibility metadata.

A material part of the device contract is underspecified.
Code generation and validation cannot be deterministic.
Rows are retained and marked Needs decision in DCM_Devicevelden.
Screen lock code is typed boolean and appears as a four-digit value on the unit.
Store only a secret hash; expose enabled state separately.
Unit repeats location name/address that already belongs to Location.
Moving or editing a location creates divergent copies.
Remove as source-of-truth; allow read-only snapshot only if offline firmware needs it.
Rights mix read/write/'-'/write-if-accepted and workflow semantics in free text.
Authorization is not enforceable or testable.
Separate role permissions from approval workflow in a policy matrix.
DCM Protocol/Protocols, Water Desinfection, Hybride; app Frequency vs unit Frequency controlled
Spelling and enum aliases are inconsistent.
Canonical enum values with explicit aliases in Enumeraties.
Project and Water Project throughout all sources

Users and developers can attach records to the wrong level.
Keep UI label Water Project; use WaterBody/WaterProject entity consistently and document hierarchy.
app street + nr split; DCM Street + nr; Country + Land code

Round-tripping app and device loses structure.
Canonical split address and ISO countryCode; countryName derived.
Chemical parameters, cover, lights, water flows, water features and sustainability appear in menus but not in the mock or completed DCM rows.
App may imply incomplete installation coverage.
Mark as device/planned scope until field and workflow contracts are specified.
app.js Test buttons, Update unit, Manual backwash, Refill

UI implies commands that are neither persisted nor sent to a unit.
Model commands/events explicitly and disable placeholders in production.

No current target, progress, failure or history state.

FirmwareUpdate state machine and version history.

Delete screens do not define dependent-allocation/protocol/history behaviour.
